narr: A boundary remain draped overhead while a deep southerly flow ushered in plenty of moisture. Showers and thunderstorms resulted in heavy rainfall that led to instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: Water was estimated to be about two to three feet deep on King Street.
VA-689 Chesterbrook Road was closed at Little Pimmit Run.
lsr: WATER ESTIMATED TO BE ABOUT 2-3 FEET DEEP ON KING STREET.
VA-689 CHESTERBROOK ROAD WAS CLOSED AT LITTLE PIMMIT RUN.
BROAD BRANCH ROAD NW CLOSED BOTH WAYS BETWEEN BRANDYWINE STREET NW & BEACH DRIVE NW DUE TO FLASH FLOODING.
